data.summary: Seasoned CX Solution Leader with 18 years of global experience in digital transformation across enterprise contact center and collaboration environments, delivering solutions across Healthcare, Banking, Consumer, Automotive and Logistics domains. Strong experience in architecting and modernizing CX platforms like Amazon Connect, Genesys Cloud, Cisco UCCE, Cisco IP Telephony and Microsoft Teams, with focus on customer journey and lifecycle management. Currently leading enterprise CX architecture, working with business and pre-sales teams to understand customer challenges and design scalable, cost-effective solutions. Hands-on experience in AI-driven CX including conversational IVR, omnichannel engagement, GenAI, sentiment analysis and automation to improve customer experience and operational efficiency. Good exposure to solution consulting, RFP/RFI, cost-benefit analysis and stakeholder management across large transformation programs.

responsibilities: Prepare high-level architecture, solution designs, and technical roadmaps for Contact Center and communication platforms, including Amazon connect, Genesys Cloud and Go to market analysis for new roadmaps.
Lead solution design workshops with business stakeholders, capturing requirements and translating them into scalable and cost-effective solutions.
Ensure solutions adhere to enterprise standards, security, and regulatory compliance while delivering measurable business outcomes.

Drive digital transformation through architected IVR call flows, conversational bot frameworks, and backend integrations with enterprise systems (Salesforce, ServiceNow, SAP, Freshdesk, CETS, TMS, Arctree).
Design and deploy AI-powered automation using Amazon Lex, Genesys Bots, Salesforce Einstein Bot, and Google Dialogflow, covering conversational design, NLU configuration, and seamless agent handoff.
Build secure, scalable, and cost-optimized native architectures
Lead Conversational IVR strategy across voice and digital channels, enabling intelligent self-service and omnichannel engagement.

Architect and implement integrations between Amazon Connect / Genesys Cloud and enterprise platforms including Salesforce (SCV) & Agent force CC with AC, ServiceNow, Freshdesk, WFM tools, and internal many applications systems.
Enhance agent productivity and customer experience through contextual routing, API-based integrations, and data-driven journey optimization.
Standardize reusable integration patterns and deployment frameworks for global rollouts.
Pre-sales initiatives by contributing to RFP/RFI responses, technical solution narratives, effort estimation, and architecture validation.
Develop Statements of Work (SOW), Level of Effort (LOE) estimates, and structured delivery plans aligned with business objectives.
Build customer-facing Proof-of-Concepts (POCs) and reusable demo environments showcasing AWS Contact Center capabilities.
Act as a trusted advisor to business and IT leadership, influencing CX strategy, cloud migration roadmaps, and long-term platform modernization.
Lead the Contact Center Engineering practice at PepsiCo Inc., overseeing program delivery, AOP, architecture, and Design and implementation of global cloud-based contact center solutions.
Manage a team of engineers, assigning tasks, conducting solution reviews, and driving delivery milestones to ensure on-time, high-quality outcomes.
Own end-to-end program and project delivery, from planning, estimation, and resource allocation to execution, rollout, risk management, and post-launch support.
Coordinate with cross-functional teams, vendors, and stakeholders to align delivery with business goals, budgets, timelines, and compliance requirements.
Customer Experience (CX) Pre-Sales and Solution Consulting across platforms including Cisco UC/UCCE,
Genesys Cloud CX, Amazon Connect , Enghouse and Microsoft Teams/Webex, guiding clients through transitions from legacy systems to modern cloud-based architectures.
Drove contact center transformation initiatives, supporting migrations from on-premises IP telephony to
Genesys Cloud, Cisco Webex Contact Center, and Microsoft collaboration ecosystems.
Delivered digital transformation solutions for enterprise clients across pharmaceutical, transportation, oil &
gas, and manufacturing sectors (e.g., BASF), aligning technology strategies with business goals.
Collaborated with ISPs, internal stakeholders, and customer teams to manage cutover planning and go-live
execution, ensuring minimal disruption and smooth telecom transitions.
Managed relationships with third-party vendors, handling quotation processes, license procurement, and
contract negotiations to enable timely, cost-efficient delivery of services.
Prepared Level of Effort (LOE) documents and contributed to Statements of Work (SOWs) based on client
requirements and delivery expectations.
Led continuous improvement initiatives, identifying operational gaps, managing project risks, and leveraging tools and metrics to drive measurable enhancements.
Oversaw managed service provider (MSP) implementations, including OPEX/CAPEX hardware procurement,
delivery tracking, and logistics coordination.
